column1: Purpose: This is the MillworkSuite reference list of all detectable and manual-entry millwork types. It is pre-filled by MillworkSuite and is READ-ONLY — do not change any codes or type names. Use the 'Your Notes' column only to flag questions or items that don't apply to your company.

column2: Fixed — this is the unique MillworkSuite code for this type. Referenced in files 04_Drafting_Catalogue.csv and 05_Pricing_Catalogue.csv. Do not change.
column3: Fixed — the category this type belongs to (Casework / Countertops / Custom Millwork / Hardware / Panels / Trim). Do not change.
column4: Fixed — Detectable means the AI can automatically identify this type from a PDF drawing. Manual Entry means your estimator must enter it by hand. Do not change.
column5: Fixed — explains how the AI detects or how the estimator enters this type. Do not change.
column6: Your use only — add any notes here. Examples: 'We never use this type', 'We call this a vanity cabinet not vanity base', 'Confirm this maps to our sink base SKU'. Leave blank if no notes.
